label: conj:q-birch-swinnerton-dyer
title: The $q$-deformed Birch and Swinnerton-Dyer conjecture
html:
Conjecture (q-BSD). Let (\mathbf{C}, \varTheta, G, \mathcal{S}) be a QOU with substrate parameter q and Descartes elliptic curve \mathcal{E}_q. Let \mathcal{E}_q(\mathbf{1}) = \mathrm{Hom}_{\mathbf{C}}(\mathbf{1}, E_q) be the categorical Mordell--Weil group with rank r_q = \mathrm{rank}\,\mathcal{E}_q(\mathbf{1}). Let L(\mathcal{E}_q, s) be the q-deformed L-function, and \mathrm{Sha}_q(\mathcal{E}_q) the q-Tate--Shafarevich group (categorical Mordell--Weil). We conjecture two parts, mirroring classical BSD:

(Weak q-BSD). The order of vanishing of L(\mathcal{E}_q, s) at s = 1 equals the categorical rank:

\mathrm{ord}_{s=1} L(\mathcal{E}_q, s) = r_q.

(Full q-BSD). The leading Taylor coefficient satisfies

\frac{L^{(r_q)}(\mathcal{E}_q, 1)}{[r_q]_q!} = \frac{\Omega_q \cdot \mathrm{Reg}_q(\mathcal{E}_q) \cdot |\mathrm{Sha}_q(\mathcal{E}_q)| \cdot \displaystyle\prod_{\mathfrak{m}} c_{\mathfrak{m}}(q)}{|\mathcal{E}_q(\mathbf{1})_{\mathrm{tors}}|^2_q},

where [r_q]_q! = [1]_q \cdot [2]_q \cdots [r_q]_q is the q-factorial, \Omega_q is the Reeb period, \mathrm{Reg}_q is the q-regulator (determinant of the q-Neron--Tate height pairing), and c_\mathfrak{m}(q) are the Tamagawa numbers.

When r_q = 0, the regulator is \mathrm{Reg}_q = 1 (determinant of the empty matrix), the torsion subgroup is trivial, and the formula collapses to

L(\mathcal{E}_q, 1) = \Omega_q \cdot |\mathrm{Sha}_q(\mathcal{E}_q)| \cdot \prod_{\mathfrak{m}} c_{\mathfrak{m}}(q).
heading: Conjecture
